question.text: Investment constraints in an IPS typically include ALL of the following EXCEPT:

explanation.text: The Logic: Daily brokerage is an execution detail, not a policy constraint. The Trap: Tax, liquidity and unique needs are classic constraints. Cross-Exam Context: NISM X-A Chapter 16 mirrors these. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Categorise every IPS item as objective, constraint or policy to avoid ambiguity.
